modern:
Turn the body inside out, and see what kind of thing it is; and what kind of thing it becomes when it has grown old, and when it is diseased.

Short-lived are both the praiser and the praised, the one who remembers and the one remembered: and all this in a corner of this part of the world; and not even here do all agree, no, not even anyone with himself: and the whole earth too is a point.

explained.summary:
Two reminders to deflate vanity. First, picture the body from the inside, and as it ages and sickens. It’s not as glamorous as it looks.

Second, fame is tiny. The person praising and the person praised both die soon, and so do those who remember. It all happens in one corner of the world, where people don’t agree with each other or even with themselves, and the whole earth is a dot in space.
explained.today: Worth remembering when a post goes viral or a rival gets the award: the audience is small, fickle and short-lived, and in a year or two few of them will recall it.
